description: Put a tab in front of the user as one of theirs: yours comes out of this task's folder, stays after the task, in the space it is signed in to. Call it when the user asked you to open or show them a page ("open their page", "show me the PR"), once the tab is that page; never for pages you only read. It is theirs after it: don't act in it again. A tab of the user's is only brought to the front.

tab.description: Tab id, as `open` or `tabs` gave it
